title: Cancel prescribed transport from the exact L2 difference energy without claiming strong control
statement: For two smooth native-velocity solutions u,w with the SAME prescribed divergence-free b, v=u-w satisfies(1/2)d_t||v||2^2+nu||grad v||2^2=-integral(v.grad)w.dot v; both u-advection and b-transport cancel. For q>3, integration by parts/Gagliardo–Nirenberg/Young gives d_t||v||2^2+nu||grad v||2^2<=C_q nu^(-(q+3)/(q-3))||w||q^(2q/(q-3))||v||2^2. A finite reference Serrin integral therefore controls L2 stability on the common lifespan WITHOUT derivative/frequency cost of b. This corrects any blanket claim that driver roughness blocks every topology. L2 proximity and integrated H1 are below 3D strong continuation; differentiating for H1 introduces[grad,b.grad]v, so no common strong/small-basin controller certificate is acquired.
